expressionInfo.title: Voting Turnout
expressionInfo.expression:
return { type : 'text', text : `${$feature.ballotscast} ballots were cast out of a possible ${$feature.regvoters} registered voters for a voter turnout of ${Round(($feature.ballotscast / $feature.regvoters) * 100, 2)}%.
Voting Method Ballots Percent
Election Day ${$feature.electionday} ${Round(($feature.electionday / $feature.ballotscast) * 100, 2)}%
Mail-in ${$feature.mail} ${Round(($feature.mail / $feature.ballotscast) * 100, 2)}%
` }
